sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 13 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "An unreal order for you. I don't know where you're going to get such a beauty, but you've never let me down before, so I trust you. I need a PKP machine gun with a Zenitco kit: handguard, buttstock and a muzzle brake. With USP-1 "Tyulpan" sight and any tactical device. Ergonomics no lower than 10, 100-round box, recoil no higher than 950."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a PKP machine gun to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +35,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.04
- 5× Physical Bitcoin
- 1× Weapon case
- Unlocks barter for TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) at Mechanic LL4
- Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov PKM 7.62x54R machine gun at Mechanic LL4
"Now that's what I call a big boy. Deserves respect. Thanks, pal."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
PKP machine gun specifications:
- 60 Durability
- Over 10 ergonomics
- 950 or less recoil
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)
- PK Zenit B-50 handguard
- PK Zenit PT-2 "Klassika" stock
- PK Zenit DTK-1P 7.62x54R muzzle brake
- NPZ USP-1 Tyulpan 4x scope
- PK 7.62x54R 100-round box

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- The PKP machine gun can only be obtained by killing Kaban on Streets of Tarkov.
- The bipod has to be taken off
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
